What this cannot reproduce

Windows 11 is confirmed. Browser version, native keyboard layout/policy, DPR, device scaling, mounting and reach are unknown. The keyboard is a local test control, not an OS replica.

The opted-in frame advertises one touch point to exercise the existing fallback. Mouse clicks remain mouse PointerEvents; coarse-pointer CSS, genuine touches, pinch gestures, screen readers, Turnstile, fullscreen lockdown and privacy-policy handling need real-device tests. Host DPR is not changed.

Geometry uses a pre-init local VirtualKeyboard facade, not a native API. No overlaysContent policy is forced. Hide uses explicit blur, not a fabricated native dismissal signal. The diagnostic shows unreported fallback behavior without patching the product's reserve.

API state is in this local server's memory, isolated by a fifteen-minute fixture cookie. Local activity renews the server's inactivity deadline; restarting loses all sample visits. Example metrics and industry reports are synthetic. Fake send acceptance does not prove delivery.
